_comment: One entry per job kind the agent handles. The generator fails when a kind is added to agent/main.go without a description here.
create: Create the data volume and the container for a server and start it.
reinstall: Delete the server's data and container and create them again.
start: Start the container (re-mounting the data volume first when needed).
stop: Stop gracefully: RCON or the console pipe for Minecraft, otherwise `docker stop`.
delete: Remove the container, its data volume and its files.
configure: Apply new limits to a running container, or (with `recreate`) remove and recreate it with new settings, ports or environment. Also resizes the data volume.
logs: Return the last lines of the container log.
command: Send one console command: RCON for Minecraft (queued on the console pipe while the server is starting), stdin for other games.
backup: Archive the server's data (from a frozen snapshot when the node uses volumes) and upload it with the signed URL.
verify-backup: Download a backup archive and check its integrity and safe extraction.
restore: Download a backup and replace the server's files with it, staging before the swap. Can restore a backup of another server (clone, failover).
file.list: List a folder in the server's data directory.
file.import: Receive an uploaded file from the panel into the server's data directory.
file.export: Send a file or folder from the server's data directory to the panel for download.
file.read: Read a text file for the editor.
file.write: Write a text file from the editor.
file.extract: Extract an archive inside the data directory with traversal protection.
file.fetch: Download one file for an add-on: HTTPS only, hosts listed in the job, public addresses only, SHA-512 (or SHA-256) must match, size counted against the disk allowance, placed atomically. An optional `replace` list removes old files only after the new one is in place.
file.delete: Delete regular files (never folders, never through symlinks).
file.rename: Rename a file; used for add-ons only to add or drop the `.disabled` suffix, never overwriting.
agent.update: Download the new agent, verify its SHA-256, trial-run it, keep the old binary as `.prev`, swap and re-execute.
evict: Remove this node's copy of a server that now lives elsewhere (failover); data is moved aside and kept for the configured retention.
